app.title: NetConfigLint v1.3
mode.snippet.detail: Checks local syntax and explicit risks in a fragment; missing external objects remain conservative.
mode.full.detail: Treats the input as a complete configuration and checks references, conflicts, omissions, and management-plane risks.
mode.snapshot.detail: Adds supported routing-table, BGP-peer, and interface operational output to full configuration analysis.
vendor.auto.detail: Detects a supported vendor from configuration evidence.
vendor.huawei.detail: Forces the Huawei VRP parser for fragments without device-identification evidence.
page.about.tagline: A fast, offline, extensible static analyzer for network device configurations.
editor.configuration.detail: This editor is included in analysis
editor.configuration.placeholder: Paste a Huawei VRP configuration or use Open above…
editor.temporary.detail: For temporary editing only; excluded from analysis and history
editor.temporary.placeholder: Organize, compare, or temporarily hold configuration text here…
analysis.empty_detail: Paste or open a Huawei VRP configuration, then run local analysis.
analysis.filter_empty_detail: Select the active severity again to show all diagnostics.
status.local: Configuration is processed locally and is not uploaded.
settings.privacy_detail: Analysis is offline. Full configurations are not written to logs or history.
settings.history_detail: Stores only counts, rule IDs, vendor, and mode. Configuration text, filenames, objects, and addresses are excluded.
history.disabled_detail: Enable privacy-safe local history in Settings to retain analysis summaries.
history.empty_detail: Completed analyses will appear here when history is enabled.
about.license: NetConfigLint is open source under the Apache License 2.0. Configuration analysis runs locally.
about.components.links: Python (PSF License) provides the core runtime; PySide6 / Qt 6 (LGPL/GPL/commercial) provides the cross-platform QML desktop UI; Nuitka builds the Windows portable application.
about.sources.detail: Rules retain only necessary structured facts and do not copy vendor manuals. Product and release differences are handled conservatively when evidence is insufficient.

about.disclaimer: Static analysis cannot guarantee operation on physical hardware. Validate production changes using vendor-supported procedures and an appropriate lab or staging environment.
